_meta.title: GOEM territory assignments
_meta.description: Official KOEL Genset OEM territory map. One GOEM may own multiple states; some states are shared/unassigned.
_meta.note: State names MUST use canonical SoI names from public/india-states.geojson (Odisha, Uttarakhand, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, etc.). Legacy names get mapped via STATE_NAME_ALIASES in IndiaMap.jsx but the source of truth here stays canonical.
